Vitality Enhancement

From Helldivers Wiki
Jump to navigation Jump to search
Boosters
Vitality Enhancement
“

Provides minor damage reduction from all sources for all Helldivers

— Armory Description

Vitality Enhancement is a Booster in Helldivers 2. When equipped, all Helldivers will be more resistant to damage and injury.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Procurement
  • 3 Tactical Information
  • 4 Armor Damage Modifiers
  • 5 Gallery
  • 6 Change History

Description

The Vitality Enhancement booster is a support booster that is designed to increase survivability when taking damage. When equipped, all Helldivers in the squad will become more resistant to damage (reduces damage taken by 10%), allowing a Helldiver to have more effective health and reduce the occurrence of limb injuries.

Procurement

The Vitality Enhancement Booster is unlocked on the 4th page of the Helldivers Mobilize Warbond for 20 Medals.

Tactical Information

  • Vitality Enhancement is a good booster for any mission type, as increased resistance allows for a Helldiver to stay in the fight longer, as well as not needing to use as many Stims to recover from limb injuries (by reducing the chance of injury outright).
  • This booster works well in more defensive missions, where the squad is required to hunker down in an area, as the limited mobility means there will be more incoming attacks. The increased survivability increases the chance of survival, as well as less reliance on Resupplies.
  • When combined with Dead Sprint, health drain caused by running is reduced from approximately 3.6% health to ~1%.
  • When using the LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle, the amount of self-damage taken from firing the weapon is decreased by a flat amount. When combined with Inflammable this prevents the weapon from dealing self-damage until 51% heat is reached.
    • The inflammable reduces all Fire-damage by 75%, reducing the 10-Fire-damage/second (26-50% heat) to 2.5 and 20 damage/second (51-90% heat) to 5. Vitality Booster reduces these damages by 1 and 2 respectively. Heavy Armor (150 AR) Reduces the damage by 2.5 and 5 respectively.
  • When combined with Advanced Filtration (AF) and Heavy Armor (HA), the Helldiver becomes virtually immune to lingering Gas-damage.
    • The Advanced Filtration alone reduces the Gas-damage/second from 25 to 5 (by 80%). By itself both Heavy Armor (150 AR) and Vitality Booster (VB) would reduce the Gas-damage by 6.25 and 2.50-points respectively.
